lineage: Transfer: Cassette  > Nak CR-7A #1 (azimuth adjusted, Dolby B) > Tascam DA-3000 #2 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > Tascam Hi Res Editor (DSF concatenate & 2496 PCM)  - Transferred by Matt Vernon Lineage:  wav 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3 > iZotope RX8 Advanced

ai_review.summary: Decent 1973 audience recording that captures a great show, though Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones are missing from this share.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised as "pretty decent for 1973," delivering a clear enough sound to enjoy the performance. Reviewers note that the concert itself was great, but two classic numbers—Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones—are absent from this particular file (they appear on the CD‑ready version). Overall the recording offers an enjoyable listening experience despite the missing tracks.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review; it rates the show positively (great) and the audience recording as decent, leading to an overall rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent clarity for a 1973 audience tape; no major flaws noted beyond typical vintage ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall great performance, though the share is missing Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones which are present on the CD version.
